research_config.assumptions: Synthetic engineering demonstration. Future demand grows 5% per year from 2040; critical share stays 250/390; LOW/HIGH are 0.8/1.25. Nominal 2035 prices and capacities persist. F is a hypothetical purchased delivery service without separate CAPEX; no Mars feasibility claim. No probability model. Original CAPEX limits remain; cumulative future cap is explicitly 2800 million 2035 units. No mandatory shocks after 2040.

assumptions.lead_rounding: ceil to whole model day; date labels skip leap days
assumptions.discount_timing: annual costs placed at year opening; preparatory stock attributed to 2035
assumptions.demand_profile: uniform daily; critical demand served first
assumptions.delivery_profile: uniform daily over the available part of the delivery year
assumptions.loss_timing: once on gross arrivals at inlet, before stock capacity check and demand issue
assumptions.holding_basis: daily average of post-arrival/pre-issue and closing physical inventory
assumptions.reserve_policy: physical opening-year stock only; unused emergency capacity gives no reserve credit
assumptions.emergency_base_definition: any strictly positive annual E order; at most two consecutive years
assumptions.preparation: rolling timely A/B/E orders may precede 2035; startup A stock is prepaid and charged in 2035
assumptions.startup_stock: net opening stock has a separate gross/loss ledger; regular annual inflow excludes it
assumptions.partial_year_reservations: annual reserved rate × available delivery days / 365; implicit rate=order/fraction
assumptions.invalid_capacity_policy: no silent order clipping; projected path is infeasible when a capacity rule fails

assumptions.cost_per_served_ton_formula: (procurement + reservation + holding + fixed_opex + capex) / actual_served_t; no double counting; all undiscounted
assumptions.discounted_cost_per_served_ton_formula: NPV(all_costs) / actual_served_t; discounted cost per physical ton, not LCOF
assumptions.delay_policy: research delay closes the arrival window; missed deliveries are not caught up in this horizon; contracted amount remains payable
assumptions.critical_demand_profile: LOW/HIGH preserve the critical share of each BASE year
assumptions.stress_service: BASE service targets are resilience benchmarks; stress shortages and missed targets generate warnings, not hard violations

optimization.scope: annual orders at fixed investments, initial inventory, explicit reservations and uniform daily delivery assumptions
optimization.objective: minimum discounted procurement + reservation + daily holding + fixed OPEX + CAPEX; 100% daily service
optimization.explanation: Минимум NPV для фиксированных инвестиционных решений и допущения равномерных поставок найден перебором всех максимальных допустимых наборов лет Emergency и решением LP для каждого. Годы инвестиций, начальный запас и явная бронь сохранены. Каждый кандидат проверен суточным расчётным ядром: нарушений нет, дефицит менее 0,000001 т. Оптимальность по другим инвестициям и произвольным графикам поставок не утверждается. Экономия является разностью стоимостей; если исходный план имеет дефицит, она не означает сравнение двух равноценных по обслуживанию стратегий.
